title: playproof.config.json
description: Defaults and named scenarios for playproof. Command-line flags override these.

target.description: URL of the game, or a folder/HTML file relative to this config file.

device.description: Default device: a Playwright device name ("Pixel 8", "iPhone 15"), "desktop", or WIDTHxHEIGHT[@SCALE] [mobile].

area.description: CSS selector of the game area (default: the largest canvas).

ready.description: JavaScript expression that is true once the game has loaded.

waitFor.description: CSS selector to wait for before starting.

baselines.description: Folder for check baselines, relative to this file (default playproof-baselines). Commit it.

scenarios.description: Named things to film. Used by --scenario <name> and by playproof check.

do.description: Steps before filming, separated by ';' (e.g. "tap @Play; wait 300ms; key Space").

script.description: File with steps, one per line, relative to this config file.

duration.description: How long to film, e.g. 700ms or 1.5s (default 1s).

fps.description: Tiles per second on the contact sheet.

zoom.description: "auto" to crop to where the motion is, or x,y,w,h in percent of the game area.

check.description: What playproof check runs besides the scenarios.
